_notes: Planet surfaces for the game prototype (game/): a hex grid on 3D terrain. The game starts in orbit: the scan shows terrain and rough deposit hints per region; the player picks a landing site, the colony pod descends, and survey rovers reveal exact deposits as they drive. terrain: move_cost = effort to enter a tile (unit speed is effort per second); height = visual relief level. planets: per planet class, how a surface is generated. Elevation and moisture come from deterministic noise (feature_size = tiles per noise cell) and are ranked, so thresholds are shares of the map: elevation ocean 0.30 = the lowest 30% of tiles are ocean, below shallows = shallows, from hills up = hills, from mountains up = mountains, the rest is lowland; within lowland, moisture picks the terrain; polar_rows at top and bottom become polar_terrain. deposits: rolled per tile on matching terrain (coastal = must touch water); amounts are ranges. hints: region totals below likely = traces, below rich = likely, otherwise rich. landing: where a colony pod may set down (tile terrain, and every neighbour must be passable land), how long it falls, what it brings (start_stock, the hub building, units) and how far the landing reveals. All numbers are placeholders.
